title: The 4 Best Massage Guns Under $200
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for massage guns under $200, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at massage guns under $200 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Opove M3 Pro 2 Massage Gun
products.blurb: Key specs: 12mm amplitude, 70 lbs stall force, 4 to 8 hour battery life.
strengths: 70 lbs stall force is high for the price, useful for glutes, hamstrings, and larger muscle groups
Long battery life means it rarely needs mid-week charging with regular use
Over 500,000 units sold with consistently high ratings across major retailers
limitations: Heavier in hand than compact travel-size guns
Fewer attachment heads included than some rivals at this price
No companion app or guided routines
features: Brushless motor rated for quiet running

products.name: Hyperice Hypervolt Go 2
products.blurb: Key specs: 1.5 lb compact body, 40W brushless motor, 3 speeds.
strengths: Among the lightest and most travel-friendly guns from a major recovery brand
QuietGlide motor keeps noise low enough for shared spaces
USB-C charging is more convenient than proprietary cables
limitations: 3 speeds is fewer than most competitors in this price range
Stall force is lower, so it bogs down under heavy pressure
Smaller head means slower coverage on large muscle groups like the back

products.name: RENPHO Active Massage Gun
products.blurb: Key specs: 5 speed settings, 5 interchangeable heads, Carry case included.
strengths: 5 heads included covers most muscle groups without buying accessories separately
Priced well below premium brands while covering the same core features
limitations: Lower stall force than the Opove for very dense muscle areas
Battery life is shorter than the Opove under continuous use
Plastic housing feels less premium than Hyperice's

products.name: TOLOCO Massage Gun
products.blurb: Key specs: 10 massage heads, Silent brushless motor, Multiple speed levels.
strengths: 10 heads included covers nearly every use case at a budget price
Frequently discounted well below its list price
limitations: Lower build quality than the other three picks here
Motor noise increases noticeably at the top two speeds
Auto shut-off at 10 minutes interrupts longer sessions

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
